why: Biggest lever in Track 1: runnable XRoar in the docs turns reading into playing, and every demo and tutorial chapter benefits. Independent of #551, so it can go at once. (The hardware checks ahead of it, #635 and #605, passed on 2026-10-26.)

The north star (on-device self-hosting). Its first spike, the postfix assembler's indexed-postbyte encoder diffed against lwasm, carries the project's biggest unknown, so start retiring it rather than polishing around it.
fc.py's silent traps cost real time in October. A warning for shadowed words protects every later piece of work, including #551's on-device dictionary.
Bulk polish of every demo, now including the jukebox and sound tour. High value but large and divisible, so it follows the gating items.
VGM streaming from disk: without it only about 28 seconds of a VGM fits, which caps what VGM support is worth. Also the way to unblock real game rips (#631).
